free_tier.stated: a trial at Pro limits that ends at the cap or after 30 days, then the account moves to Free with nothing deleted; a parked workspace uses no compute and keeps its memory and processes

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: Outbound transfer is a monthly allowance by plan: 100 GB Developer (USD 9), 250 GB Pro (USD 29), 1 TB Startup, 5 TB Scale, and 250 GB during the 7-day signup trial. There is no overage price: at 100 % of the allowance outbound internet traffic is blocked until the next period or an upgrade
egress.free_allowance: 250 GB during the 7-day trial; 100 GB a month on Developer

interface_detail: HTTP API, the `shard` CLI, and TypeScript and Python SDKs (`npm i @shardflux/sdk`); an E2B SDK compatibility mode; no SSH access found in the docs read

limits.value: the trial runs at Pro limits for 30 days or until the cap, then the account drops to Free with nothing deleted
a workspace parks seconds after its last call and uses no compute while suspended

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not documented. email is the assumed default because priced hosts require an account; sign-up requirements are unconfirmed for this provider.

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
confidence_note: the pricing page was read on 2026-10-22 and states the trial's 30-day life, the parked-state behaviour and that nothing is deleted when it ends. The 30-day clock is the fact, and the parked state preserving memory is the state answer

evidence.proved: listed in the peli-cloud corpus card at commit f6a71ab0; the card is the source, not the vendor page

'Each workspace is a Linux microVM with its own kernel, disk and memory. Shardflux creates it, parks it, wakes it and keeps its state' and 'A workspace parks seconds after its last call, and the next call wakes it. Suspended, it uses no compute.' and 'Suspend and resume keep its memory and running processes, so the dev server is still on its port.' and 'At the cap or after 30 days the account is on Free, with nothing deleted.', quoted

evidence.quote: Storage and outbound transfer have no overage. Retained state and shared volumes are never charged, and outbound traffic is still blocked at 100 % of the transfer allowance.

evidence.quote: New accounts can register automatically via the console, CLI (`shard signup`) or HTTP API

extras.keep_rate_basis: billed for uptime (no suspension feature published)

shape.note: the free shape is 1 vCPU and 2 GiB; Pro reaches 4 vCPU and 8 GiB per workspace, up to 8 vCPU and 16 GiB each on larger plans

session_cap.note: parks seconds after the last call; suspend keeps memory and running processes, so the dev server is still on its port when it wakes

extras.price_note: a price without a shape and a horizon is not a price; both columns are kept because the two seed models disagree and neither is wrong
